Danny Kramer is an American actor for the English dub of . He is currently affiliated with DDO Artists Agency.

==Biography==
Kramer is an American voice actor born on April 3, 1990. After working on TV and film, Kramer became a voice actor and was heard in several commercials before working on Pokémon. Kramer's most notable role so far is that of Hammerlocke Gym Leader Raihan.

==Pokémon roles==
====Humans====
